removed_exports.record_entropy: Shannon entropy over SplitMix64 record-hash values; saturated at ln(committed patch count) by construction because the hash keys include per-node incidence slots
removed_exports.record_signature: per-node SplitMix64 hash previously exported as a screen/harmonic/freezeout scalar field

replacement_exports.record_packet_entropy: trace scalar: Shannon entropy (nats) over the multiset of committed physical record packets
replacement_exports.record_port_entropy: per-patch scalar field: Shannon entropy (nats) of the canonical record port multiset
replacement_exports.record_packet_id: per-patch dense content id over physical record packets; observer/record-family bookkeeping token, not a harmonic-analysis field

packet.packet_definition: per-patch physical record packet: the canonical echosahedral record port row (group-element indices after the node-frame gauge quotient), the exact content whose cross-cycle stability defines a commit
packet.port_value_encoding: exact group-element indices; the packet is integer-valued, no float binning
packet.modular_depth_status: not part of the packet: the array commit machinery binds port/gauge state only, and modular depth is exported separately as its own field
packet.entropy_definition: Shannon entropy over the multiset of packets on committed patches; 0.0 when no patch is committed
packet.mirrors: the E0 approach (entropy over committed record content, oph_fpe.core.patch_state.PatchState.observer_packet); E0's committed record additionally carries that engine's scalar/modular bins because they are part of E0's record content

hash_token_status: SplitMix64 node signatures remain internal record-change/commit bookkeeping and the patch-state binding token; they are not exported as observables
content_diversity_note: record_packet_entropy measures exact committed-record content diversity: equal content collapses to one outcome. Under the current iid-random initialization of unrouted patch ports the record population is near-maximally diverse, so values near ln(committed count) report state content, not a hash artifact; the value is reproducible from the patch-state artifact's canonical_record_port_state and committed arrays
